story.title: Monster Marley and Healthy Henry
paragraphs_en: I have something to tell you and nobody else can know. All of us have a food shadow, but it doesn’t really show. Yes, it’s true! You have a food shadow and I do too. It could be Monster Marley or Healthy Henry following you. Can you keep a secret?

Healthy Henry is your healthy food shadow. So fit and strong. He is perfect from head to toe. He has a roti for his body and rice for his hair. A carrot for his nose, that points up in the air. An olive for each eye and broccoli ears that are in style. He wears a fruit bowl hat, but best of all is his smile. If you exercise daily and choose your foods well, Healthy Henry will be your shadow, as you can tell.

But if you like your chips and cookies and we all know how much you do. Don’t eat too much of it or Monster Marley will follow you. His body is one big chocolate cookie and he has noodles for his hair. A pizza slice for his nose with cheese dripping everywhere. He has toffee for his eyes and elephant like potato chip ears. His limbs are made of lollies . Eww! How gross he appears.

Now Monster Marley and Healthy Henry don’t quite get along. So who gets to stay? It depends on whether you eat right or wrong. You say, you don’t believe me! Let me tell you about Nancy. She ate too many chips and loved her sweets and candy. Now Monster Marley and Healthy Henry don’t quite get along. So who gets to stay? It depends on whether you eat right or wrong. You say you don’t believe me! Let me tell you about Nancy . She ate too many chips and loved her sweets and candy .

Who do you think won this food shadow fight? Of course Monster Marley, you guessed it right! Nancy could not see it and frankly did not care. But her shadow was slowing her down everywhere. She would get stuck on the slide, for her shadow was too heavy. And her lollypop limbs were so sticky, it made her walk unsteady. She would get stuck on the slide, for her shadow was too heavy. Nancy could not see it and frankly did not care. But her shadow was slowing her down everywhere.

No friends came near her, for her nose was always dripping cheese. They all ran away from Nancy when she began to sneeze. No friends came near her, for her nose was always dripping cheese . They all ran away from Nancy when she began to sneeze.

Her hair was a big entangled mess, gathering dirt and catching a lot of flea. Her eyes were always droopy, they would water when watching TV. Her teeth were very weak, they looked like soft marshmallows. They could barely bite into anything and were stained a dirty yellow.

Then one day Nancy went crying to her mum, for she had had enough. She said, “I am ready to eat right, I just want to be tough”. Mum was so happy and relieved, that finally Nancy understood. She told her to drink plenty of water and eat foods that were healthy and good. Then one day Nancy went crying to her mum, for she had had enough. She said, “I am ready to eat right, I just want to be tough”. Mum was so happy and relieved, that finally Nancy understood. She told her to drink plenty of water and eat foods that were healthy and good.

The water washed out Monster Marley a nd just like that he was gone forever. Healthy Henry returned as Nancy’s shadow, fitter and stronger than ever. The water washed out Monster Marley and just like that he was gone forever. Healthy Henry returned as Nancy’s shadow, fitter and stronger than ever.

Nancy felt very energetic, her laziness was overcome. She was so glad that she had finally listened to her mum. Now she could run very fast and go down the slide quickly. She never had a cold or cough and could bite into apples easily. Nancy felt very energetic, her laziness was overcome. She was so glad that she had finally listened to her mum. Now she could run very fast and go down the slide quickly. She never had a cold or cough and could bite into apples easily.

She was very bright in school, of that there was no doubt. Nancy needed Healthy Henry. She knew she couldn’t live without. But she still loved her cookies and candies. They sure made her smile. Healthy Henry didn’t mind a treat, as long as it was only once in a while. She was very bright in school, of that there was no doubt. Nancy needed Healthy Henry . She knew she couldn’t live without. But she still loved her cookies and candies . They sure made her smile . Healthy Henry didn’t mind a treat, as long as it was only once in a while.

Now look behind you and tell me, who do you see? Clumsy Monster Marley or Healthy Henry? Let this be our little secret. Oh! Please don’t tell. And if you ever see Monster Marley, don’t forget to scream and yell .

items.text_en: I have something to tell you and nobody else can know.
All of us have a food shadow, but it doesn’t really show.
Yes, it’s true!
You have a food shadow and I do too.
It could be Monster Marley or Healthy Henry following you.
Can you keep a secret?
Healthy Henry is your healthy food shadow.
So fit and strong.
He is perfect from head to toe.
He has a roti for his body and rice for his hair.
A carrot for his nose, that points up in the air.
An olive for each eye and broccoli ears that are in style.
He wears a fruit bowl hat, but best of all is his smile.
If you exercise daily and choose your foods well, Healthy Henry will be your shadow, as you can tell.
But if you like your chips and cookies and we all know how much you do.
Don’t eat too much of it or Monster Marley will follow you.
His body is one big chocolate cookie and he has noodles for his hair.
A pizza slice for his nose with cheese dripping everywhere.
He has toffee for his eyes and elephant like potato chip ears.
His limbs are made of lollies .
Eww! How gross he appears.
Now Monster Marley and Healthy Henry don’t quite get along.
So who gets to stay?
It depends on whether you eat right or wrong.
